title: 物流與包裹
description: 寄送與收取包裹的用語

sentences.en: I would like to track the status of my package, which was shipped five days ago but has not yet arrived at the expected destination.
sentences.zh: 我想追蹤我包裹的狀態，它五天前已寄出但尚未到達預期目的地。

sentences.en: The tracking number provided shows that the delivery was marked as completed, even though I never received the package at my address.
sentences.zh: 提供的追蹤號碼顯示投遞已標記為完成，即使我在我的地址從未收到過包裹。

sentences.en: Could you please arrange for the parcel to be held at the nearest pickup point, since no one will be home during delivery hours?
sentences.zh: 由於送貨時間內沒有人在家，您能否安排將包裹保留在最近的取件點？

sentences.en: The fragile items I shipped were not packaged with sufficient protective material, resulting in significant damage upon arrival.
sentences.zh: 我寄送的易碎物品沒有用足夠的保護材料包裝，導致到達時有嚴重損壞。

sentences.en: I need to send an urgent document to our overseas office, and I am wondering which express shipping option guarantees next-day delivery.
sentences.zh: 我需要寄一份緊急文件到我們的海外辦公室，想知道哪種快遞選項保證隔日送達。

sentences.en: The courier attempted delivery twice while I was at work, and now the package has been returned to the distribution center.
sentences.zh: 快遞員在我上班時嘗試投遞了兩次，現在包裹已被退回配送中心。

sentences.en: Having compared several shipping providers, I found that the premium service offers both insurance coverage and real-time tracking updates.
sentences.zh: 比較了幾家快遞供應商後，我發現高級服務提供保險覆蓋和即時追蹤更新。

sentences.en: I am filing a claim for a lost package that was supposed to arrive two weeks ago, according to the estimated delivery window provided.
sentences.zh: 我正在對一個根據提供的預計送達時間應在兩週前到達的遺失包裹提出索賠。

sentences.en: The delivery driver left the package outside my front door without ringing the bell, exposing it to potential theft and weather damage.
sentences.zh: 送貨司機把包裹留在我家門外沒有按門鈴，使其面臨被偷和天氣損壞的風險。

sentences.en: Could you provide an updated estimated arrival time for my shipment, which has been stuck in customs clearance for over a week?
sentences.zh: 您能提供我貨物的更新預計到達時間嗎？它已經在海關清關卡了一個多星期。

sentences.en: I specifically selected signature-required delivery to ensure that the valuable contents would be handed directly to an authorized recipient.
sentences.zh: 我特別選擇了需要簽名的投遞方式，以確保貴重物品會直接交到授權收件人手中。

sentences.en: The shipping cost for this relatively small item seems disproportionately high, and I would like to understand the pricing breakdown.
sentences.zh: 這件相對較小的物品的運費似乎不成比例地高，我想了解定價的明細。

sentences.en: Since the original delivery address was incorrect, I need to redirect the package to my workplace before it reaches the wrong location.
sentences.zh: 由於原始送貨地址不正確，我需要在包裹到達錯誤地點之前將其重新導向我的工作地點。

sentences.en: The company's return shipping label has expired, and I am unable to generate a new one through the online portal without customer support.
sentences.zh: 公司的退貨運送標籤已過期，我無法在沒有客服支援的情況下通過線上入口生成新的。

sentences.en: I was informed that international shipments to that particular country require additional customs documentation, including a detailed contents declaration.
sentences.zh: 我被告知寄往該特定國家的國際貨物需要額外的海關文件，包括詳細的物品申報。

sentences.en: The scheduled delivery window was between nine and twelve, but the driver did not arrive until nearly four in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 預定送貨時段是九點到十二點之間，但司機直到下午將近四點才到達。

sentences.en: I would appreciate a refund on the expedited shipping fee, given that the package arrived three days later than the guaranteed delivery date.
sentences.zh: 鑑於包裹比保證送達日期晚了三天才到，我希望能退還加急運費。

sentences.en: The package dimensions exceed the standard size limits, which means additional oversized item surcharges will apply to this shipment.
sentences.zh: 包裹尺寸超過了標準尺寸限制，這意味著此次寄送將收取額外的超大物品附加費。

sentences.en: After three failed delivery attempts, the logistics company informed me that I must collect the parcel from their depot within five business days.
sentences.zh: 在三次投遞失敗後，物流公司通知我必須在五個工作日內從他們的倉庫取回包裹。

sentences.en: I arranged for a Saturday delivery specifically because I work during the week, yet the package was delivered on a Wednesday instead.
sentences.zh: 我特別安排了週六送貨因為我平日上班，然而包裹卻在週三被投遞了。

sentences.en: The contents of my package were clearly tampered with during transit, as the seal was broken and several items were missing from inside.
sentences.zh: 我的包裹內容物在運送途中明顯被篡改了，因為封條已破損且裡面有幾件物品不見了。

sentences.en: Could you clarify whether the free shipping promotion applies to all orders over fifty dollars, or only to selected categories of products?
sentences.zh: 您能澄清免運費促銷是適用於所有超過五十美元的訂單，還是只適用於特定類別的產品？

sentences.en: The neighbor who accepted the package on my behalf mentioned that the box was already visibly dented when the driver handed it over.
sentences.zh: 代我簽收包裹的鄰居提到，司機交接時箱子就已經明顯凹陷了。

sentences.en: I need to ship a temperature-sensitive medication overseas and require information about cold-chain logistics options available through your service.
sentences.zh: 我需要寄送對溫度敏感的藥物到海外，需要了解你們服務提供的冷鏈物流選項的資訊。

sentences.en: The automated notification stated that my package is out for delivery, but the estimated time window has already passed without any update.
sentences.zh: 自動通知顯示我的包裹正在派送中，但預估時段已經過了卻沒有任何更新。

sentences.en: Given the high value of the shipment, I would like to purchase additional insurance coverage beyond the standard liability included.
sentences.zh: 鑑於貨物的高價值，我想購買超出所含標準責任範圍的額外保險。

sentences.en: The post office clerk explained that registered mail provides proof of delivery and is recommended for important legal documents.
sentences.zh: 郵局職員解釋說掛號信提供投遞證明，推薦用於重要的法律文件。

sentences.en: I have been waiting at home all morning for a delivery that was rescheduled without my consent to a time that conflicts with my afternoon commitments.
sentences.zh: 我整個上午都在家等待一個未經我同意就被重新安排到與我下午行程衝突的時間的送貨。

sentences.en: The bulk shipping rate, applicable to businesses sending more than fifty parcels per month, would significantly reduce our operational costs.
sentences.zh: 適用於每月寄送超過五十個包裹的企業的大宗運費費率，將大幅降低我們的營運成本。

sentences.en: Please ensure that the delivery instructions specify leaving the package at the back door, as the front entrance is not accessible from the street.
sentences.zh: 請確保送貨指示註明將包裹放在後門，因為前門入口從街道上無法進入。
